headword: {本能寺|ほんのうじ}の{変|へん}

definitions.explanation: The 1582 coup in which the general Akechi Mitsuhide attacked his lord Oda Nobunaga at the Honnōji temple in Kyoto. Nobunaga died there, just as he was close to unifying Japan.

examples.japanese: {本能寺|ほんのうじ}の{変|へん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧1582⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: The Honnōji Incident took place in 1582.

examples.japanese: {本能寺|ほんのうじ}の{変|へん}で{信長|のぶなが}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{死|し}んだ→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧。
examples.english: Nobunaga died in the Honnōji Incident.

examples.japanese: {光秀|みつひで}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なぜ→なぜ：01484_naze⟧{本能寺|ほんのうじ}の{変|へん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こした→起こす：01234_okosu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦はっきり→はっきり：01228_hakkiri⟧わかって⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Why Mitsuhide carried out the Honnōji Incident is still not clearly known.

notes:
After the incident, Toyotomi Hideyoshi quickly defeated Mitsuhide and went on to complete the unification of Japan. Mitsuhide held power for only about two weeks, which gave rise to the phrase {三日天下|みっかてんか} (a very short-lived reign).
